data.name: SimpleElevator
data.description:
### SimpleElevator
Adds a buildable elevator to sons of the forest. 
Works In:
 - Singeplayer
 - Multiplayer
 - Dedicated Server




#### How To Build:
##### Elevator:
- Open book and place out elevator


#####Control Panel:

- Open book and place out control panel




#### How To Use Elevator:
**NOTE:** There needs to be a control panel on each floor you want the elevator to stop on. If there is no control panel the elevator won't move.


- Place a control panel on each floor you want the elevator to have. `Control panel` need to be on the edge or close by to where the elevator movement will be. E.G mod picture.


- Place out the elevator


- `2` Ways To Move The Elevator:
   Press Call from the Control Panel or scroll up `or `  scroll up/down on the elevator itself (UP Or DOWN message will show on display) and then press the interact key

Default Interact Key: `E` (Can Be Changed I Mods Settings)



#### How To Destroy Elevator:


- Take out **RepairTool**
- Hit ether a `Control panel ` or `Elevator ` and it will destroy itself (No Items Given Back)

By SmokyAce, all code is free for use on [GitHub](https://github.com/move123456789/SOTF-Mods/tree/SimpleElevator)
